description.value: The Landlubber Pub is a family-owned neighbourhood pub in Nanaimo's Beban Plaza with nearly 30 years of history serving a wide-ranging local clientele. It is known for wing night four nights a week with over 30 flavours, homemade comfort food, and a lively entertainment calendar including karaoke, music trivia, poker nights, and open mic sessions. Located at the corner of Bowen and Northfield roads, it sits on two bus routes and draws everyone from post-work regulars to weekend brunch crowds.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (10-2220 Bowen Road, Beban Plaza, Nanaimo), phone (250-758-9400), and active operations with weekly specials, entertainment schedules, and Instagram activity. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are explicitly mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null per evidence rules. The business is clearly a real, operating neighbourhood pub.
concerns: Minor copy inconsistency: front page says 'over 30 years' while About Us says 'almost 30 years of family ownership' — not a material concern.
Website email (landlubberpub@shaw.ca) is present on site but absent from OSM tags — worth adding to the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible neighbourhood pub in Nanaimo with a verified website and consistent contact details — a straightforward inclusion for the directory.

wow_evidence: family-owned neighbourhood pub in Nanaimo's Beban Plaza with nearly 30 years of history
